title: Objection
description: A challenge raised against a claim within the CCSR protocol.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this objection belongs to.

target_claim_id.description: ID of the claim being objected to.

author_agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that raised this objection.

reason.description: Explanation of why this claim is being challenged.

requested_fix.description: Suggested fix or resolution, or null if not specified.

resolved.description: Whether this objection has been resolved.

resolution_claim_id.description: ID of the claim that resolves this objection, or null if unresolved.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this objection.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this objection was created.
